Proposed Zoning: | 83-2 Community Shopping District

Lot Area: 6.406 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to establish a gym/health club at the subject
property. The height and footprint of the existing one-story masonry
building will remain without change. Only interior renovations are required
to establish the proposed use within the 6,312 sq. ft. space. The subject
property is a Transit Served Location and will not provide off-street
parking. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative
Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE of the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street
parking requirement for a Transit Served Location to zero and is seeking all
relief necessary, as allowed by the code, for the attached plans.

off-street parking requirement to zero.
